title: Time
description: Class 4 IMO — Time: the 12-hour and 24-hour clock, converting hours to minutes and minutes to seconds, working out durations, calendar problems and reading timetables.

topics.title: 12-hour & 24-hour Clock
topics.concept:
The 12-hour clock uses a.m. (before noon) and p.m. (after noon). The 24-hour clock counts the hours from 0 to 23, so afternoon times keep going: 1 p.m. is 13:00 and 8 p.m. is 20:00.

To change a p.m. time to 24-hour, add 12 to the hours. Midnight is 00:00 and noon is 12:00.
recap: p.m. to 24-hour: add 12 to the hours.

topics.title: Converting Units & Finding Duration
topics.concept:
There are 60 minutes in an hour and 60 seconds in a minute. To change hours to minutes, multiply by 60; to change minutes to seconds, multiply by 60.

To find a duration, add the interval to the start time: 9:00 + 2 hours 30 minutes = 11:30.

examples.problem: A bus leaves at 9:00 and travels for 2 hours 30 minutes. When does it arrive?

topics.title: Calendars & Timetables
topics.concept:
A calendar helps us find the day for a date and count the days between two dates. From 10 March to 15 March is 5 days.

A timetable lists start and end times. The journey length is the end time minus the start time.

examples.problem: How many days are there from 10 March to 15 March?
A train leaves at 9:00 and arrives at 11:30. How long is the journey?

recap: Days between dates = later date − earlier date.
Journey time = arrival time − departure time.

quiz.q: How many days are there from 1 January to 8 January?
A class runs from 10:00 to 10:45. How long is it?

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three are units of time)?
questions.explanation: Metre measures length; the others measure time.

questions.q: An activity starts at 8:15 and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes. When does it end?
A film runs from 6:30 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. How long is it?
School runs from 8:00 to 14:00. How many hours is that?
How many days are there from 5 April to 12 April?
How many minutes are there in 2 hours 15 minutes?
A night journey starts at 22:00 and lasts 5 hours. When does it end?
questions.explanation: 22:00 + 5 hours = 27:00, which is 03:00 the next day.
